title: Lockpicking Primer
description: follow me back to where it all began: picking locks. There is no skill that will serve you better when the going gets tough! Take a chance, roll the dice, set yourself free.

title: Community FIXIT Forum
description: Join me and friends as we gather to create a no-judgement environment where you can come to learn how to fix things. Bring your broken shit and we'll see if we can't fix it together. Bring buddies and hang out but with screwdrivers and spitting in the face of consumerism also!

title: SEPTEMBER HACKPACK ADDITION
description: IT'S FINALLY HERE! Friends, Romans, countrymen... I bring you, the Monthly Hackpack Add. You will leave this class with a dangerous gadget and the knowhow to use it, at no cost to you. Seize the day, bite the hand, HACK THE PLANET.
